name: Planned_obsolescence
source:
In the year 21XX, humble Bitcoin miners struggle to eke out a living while cults dedicated to various circa-2018 tech companies vie for supremacy across the post-apocalyptic wastes.  A young woman explores what remains of a world ravaged by drone warfare, mass surveillance, climate change, and STEMlords. 

PLANNED_OBSOLESCENCE is a timely, surreal, and darkly funny visual novel about the  near future. This is a demo/prologue that goes through the first 20-30 minutes of a possibly longer game (expansion contingent on general interest). There are six endings - make sure to collect all the DATA you can. 
[From [url=https://nrsm-ha.itch.io/obsolete-demo] itch.io[/url]]
